SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD B JOIN MEMBER ON (BOARD_WRITER = MEMBER_NO) WHERE B.STATUS = 'Y'
AND MEMBER_ID
AND BOARD_TITLE
AND BOARD_CONTENT
LIKE '%${keyword}%'

SELECT BOARD_NO, CATEGORY_NAME, BOARD_TITLE, MEMBER_ID, COUNT, TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATE_DATE FROM BOARD A JOIN CATEGORY USING(CATEGORY_NO) JOIN MEMBER C ON A.BOARD_WRITER = C.MEMBER_NO WHERE A.STATUS = 'Y' AND A.BOARD_TYPE = 1 ORDER BY A.BOARD_NO DESC

SELECT BOARD_NO, CATEGORY_NAME, BOARD_TITLE, MEMBER_ID, COUNT, TO_CHAR(CREATE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATE_DATE FROM BOARD A JOIN CATEGORY USING(CATEGORY_NO) JOIN MEMBER C ON A.BOARD_WRITER = C.MEMBER_NO WHERE A.STATUS = 'Y' AND A.BOARD_TYPE = 1
AND C.MEMBER_ID
AND BOARD_TITLE
AND BOARD_CONTENT
LIKE '%${keyword}%' ORDER BY A.BOARD_NO DESC

INSERT INTO BOARD( BOARD_NO, BOARD_TYPE, BOARD_TITLE, BOARD_CONTENT, BOARD_WRITER, COUNT, CREATE_DATE, STATUS ) VALUES ( SEQ_BNO.NEXTVAL, #{boardType}, #{boardTitle}, #{boardContent}, #{boardWriter}, 0, SYSDATE, 'Y' )

INSERT INTO ATTACHMENT ( FILE_NO, REF_BNO, ORIGIN_NAME, CHANGE_NAME, FILE_PATH, FILE_LEVEL, UPLOAD_DATE ) VALUES ( SEQ_FNO.NEXTVAL, SEQ_BNO.CURRVAL, #{originName}, #{changeName}, #{filePath}, #{fileLevel}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT FILE_NO, REF_BNO, ORIGIN_NAME, CHANGE_NAME, FILE_PATH, UPLOAD_DATE, FILE_LEVEL, STATUS FROM ATTACHMENT WHERE REF_BNO = #{boardNo} AND STATUS = 'Y'
